source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 13 mai — «Sfântul Cuvios Serghie Mărturisitorul»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 13ης Μαΐου — «Όσιος Σέργιος ο Ομολογητός»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 13 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same civil day the Romanian calendar already keeps him on, and it is plainly the same man: the confessor dispossessed and exiled under the iconoclast Theophilos. **He is none of the corpus's ten other Sergii**, which the namesweep flagged and which were read; this one is told apart by his family, and the family is what the Greek adds. **The page names three of his own and the corpus keeps two**: his son Photius, «τιμάται 6 Φεβρουαρίου», and his brother the patriarch Tarasius (784–806), both linked; his wife Irene, exiled with him, has no folder and is named without a link. **No year of any kind**, so the folder is given no `dates` object; the only dates on the page are the two reigns. **No hymn**, and the page's couplet is a dialogue — how do you end your life, Sergius? I have died a common death, and I am alive to you.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue at pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (20 September 2026).
